YOUR NOBLETON

Thinking about your next move?

Connect the value of your current home with the cost and timing of your next one.

On this page

  • Start with two numbers
  • Buying before selling
  • Selling before buying
  • Check your current mortgage
  • More about life in Nobleton

Start with two numbers

What might your current home sell for, and what can you comfortably afford next? Request a market evaluation and review your financing before making commitments. Estimated sale proceeds should account for your mortgage balance, selling costs and any applicable mortgage charges.

Buying before selling

You may secure your next home first, but this can create overlapping carrying costs and uncertainty about sale proceeds. Ask your mortgage professional whether bridge financing is available and what conditions apply; it is not automatic.

Selling before buying

Knowing your sale terms can make planning easier. Consider temporary accommodation, moving and storage costs if closing dates do not align. Discuss timing, conditions and contingencies with your representative and lawyer.

Check your current mortgage

Ask about portability, discharge costs and any prepayment penalty before you decide on a sale date. Your lender or mortgage professional can explain the options in your actual contract.

General information, not personalized financial or legal advice. Eligibility and actual terms depend on the lender, insurer and property. Reviewed November 9, 2026.
